title: Customizations
description: V20 — "Your panel" (fork of V19, from the Nov 18 standup + Nov 19 Agents Window Sync feedback). The side panel turns into a session status view that you can customize: a "Used in This Session" section shows what the agent loaded or called, with cost, stalls and per-session overrides. A Customize view (footer link, or the section header context menu) has presets (Minimal / Default / Troubleshooting / Everything), lets you show, hide and reorder sections by dragging, and sets row options. You can hide a section from its header on hover. Sign-ins needed right now are asked for in the chat, above the input (try the Settings prototype session), not in the panel. A wide panel adds a Source column.
